description: Label Compile. Compile a label to printer commands (tsc, zpl, epl, …). POST width, language, and elements. Text uses content and size (1-10), not text or fontSize. No barcode element. Example: {"width":40,"height":30,"unit":"mm","language":"zpl","element… Credit cost: 3 credits per call.

elements.description: Required array. Text items need type=text, content, and size (1-10 magnification). Do not use text, fontSize, or type=barcode. Positions x/y are in dots. Example item: {"type":"text","content":"Order: 1042","x":10,"y":10,"size":2}.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gap.description: Gap between labels in mm. Ignored for receipts.

height.description: Label height in the same unit. Example: 30. Omit for receipt / continuous mode.

language.description: Required printer language. Example: zpl or tsc. Do not omit. Allowed values: tsc, zpl, epl, cpcl, dpl, sbpl, escpos, starprnt, ipl. Default: "tsc".

unit.description: Measurement unit for width and height. Default mm. Use mm unless you are working in printer dots. Allowed values: mm, inch, dot. Default: "mm".

width.description: Label width. Required. Default unit is mm. Example: 40. Do not send query instead of width.

name: label_compile
title: Label Compile
